audit.summary: The 300×250 BYD SEALION 5 DM-i ad creative meets all critical audit requirements. The ad is rendered at the correct IAB pixel dimensions (300×250 px), the BYD logo is clearly visible and appropriately scaled in the top-left, typography hierarchy is strong with 'SEALION 5 DM-i' as the primary headline, the color palette adheres to the style guide (BYD red #EC1C24 for the header bar and CTA button, black and white text), and the primary CTA button 'DÉCOUVRIR MAINTENANT' has adequate spacing from the bottom edge. The product hero image (SEALION 5 DM-i SUV) is visible and high-quality across all three states (initial, animated, settled), with a dynamic carousel rotation showing different vehicle angles. The French copy is accurate ('SUV rechargeable', 'à partir de 36 990 €'). No blockers detected.
